title: Tickets
key_points: Tickets are a type of account in the XRP Ledger.
They provide a way to create and manage accounts without direct user control.
Ticket accounts can be used for various purposes, such as representing entities or resources.
Tickets have a fixed lifespan and can be revoked or canceled before their expiration date.
The owner of a ticket account can specify conditions for its use, such as required payments or permissions.
limitations: The scope of the documentation may not cover all possible uses and scenarios for tickets.
Some advanced features or potential limitations of tickets are not described in detail.
The effectiveness and security of using tickets depend on proper implementation and management.
asserts: Tickets provide a way to create and manage accounts in the XRP Ledger without direct user control, allowing specified conditions for use and a fixed lifespan.
